ch3_radio.speaker: narrator
ch3_radio.text: Evening. Joseph has switched the radio back on. Everyone on the hill is listening to something tonight.

ch3_radio.speaker: radio
ch3_radio.text: This is a special announcement. The plane carrying the President of the Republic, Juvénal Habyarimana, was shot down this evening as it approached Kigali.

ch3_radio.speaker: radio
ch3_radio.text: [Then silence. Then music. Then, through the night, other voices, calling for something terrible.]
ch3_radio.text_reduced: [Then silence, and then voices full of anger.]

ch3_radio.speaker: joseph
ch3_radio.text: Bolt the door, Emmanuel. And do not go to sleep in your clothes tonight. Keep your shoes on.

ch3_night.speaker: narrator
ch3_night.text: Hours later, Emmanuel wakes to shouting somewhere across the valley. Dogs are barking. Someone is running on the path.

ch3_night.speaker: joseph
ch3_night.text: Stay inside. Listen carefully. Whatever happens, don't mistake cruelty for courage.

ch3_night.speaker: narrator
ch3_night.text: A knock at the door. Soft, fast, frightened.

ch3_night.speaker: aline
ch3_night.text: I don't know where my brother is. People are searching for us. Please—

ch3_night.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_night.text: Come in. We'll figure out what we can do.

ch3_night.speaker: joseph
ch3_night.text: We have to protect the people in our care. Quietly, and together.

ch3_night.speaker: aline
ch3_night.text: They came to our house. Everyone ran. Olivier ran too, and I lost him in the dark. He's ten, Emmanuel. He's only ten.

choices.text: "Papa, I have to go and look."

ch3_night.speaker: joseph
ch3_night.text: Then go the way the shadows go. Stay low, keep to the tall grass, and if anyone sees you, come straight back. Do not try to be brave. Be careful.

ch3_night.speaker: aline
ch3_night.text: He loves the football field. He goes there when he's scared. He thinks nobody can find him there.

ch3_night.speaker: joseph
ch3_night.text: And Emmanuel, Gasana lives alone by his storehouse. If you pass that way, see if he is there.

ch3_joseph_wait.speaker: joseph
ch3_joseph_wait.text: Go quietly. Come back to me.

ch3_sandal.speaker: narrator
ch3_sandal.text: In the grass at the edge of the pitch lies a small sandal. One strap has been mended with string, the way Aline mends everything.

ch3_sandal.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_sandal.text: Olivier was here. But where did he go?

ch3_claudine.speaker: narrator
ch3_claudine.text: Behind the house, pressed into the shadow of the wall, Claudine is holding Eric so tightly he can barely breathe.

ch3_claudine.speaker: claudine
ch3_claudine.text: Emmanuel? Oh, thank God. I thought you were one of them.

ch3_claudine.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_claudine.text: Have you seen Olivier? Aline's brother?

ch3_claudine.speaker: claudine
ch3_claudine.text: A boy ran past an hour ago, towards the market. Towards Mama Beata's. I think it was him.

choices.text: "Come with me to my father's house. You'll be safer there."
"Stay hidden here. I'll come back for you."

ch3_claudine.speaker: claudine
ch3_claudine.text: Eric, hold my hand. Don't let go. We stay right behind Emmanuel.

ch3_claudine.speaker: narrator
ch3_claudine.text: Somewhere close, a torch beam swings across the path.

ch3_claudine_stay.speaker: claudine
ch3_claudine_stay.text: Will you take us with you now?

ch3_gasana.speaker: narrator
ch3_gasana.text: The storehouse door is open a crack. Inside, among the sacks Emmanuel once carried, an old man sits very still.

ch3_gasana.speaker: gasana
ch3_gasana.text: Emmanuel. They have been past twice. They asked for me by name.

choices.text: "Come with me. My father sent me for you."
"Stay hidden. I'll tell my father where you are."

ch3_gasana.speaker: gasana
ch3_gasana.text: Joseph sent you? Then I will come. Slowly. My legs are older than my courage.

ch3_gasana.speaker: gasana
ch3_gasana.text: Tell him I am here. Tell him I am grateful.

ch3_gasana_follow.speaker: gasana
ch3_gasana_follow.text: Go on. I am behind you.

ch3_beata.speaker: narrator
ch3_beata.text: The back window of the shop is shuttered. Emmanuel taps on the wood, once, twice.

ch3_beata.speaker: beata
ch3_beata.text: Who is it? Emmanuel? Speak quietly.

ch3_beata.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_beata.text: Olivier, Aline's brother. Claudine saw him run this way.

ch3_beata.speaker: beata
ch3_beata.text: He was here. He was so frightened he couldn't speak. But there were men at the front door, and he slipped out the back, towards the banana groves, before I could stop him.

ch3_beata.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_beata.text: Then I'll look in the groves.

ch3_beata.speaker: beata
ch3_beata.text: No. Listen to me. There are men in the groves too. You will not find him tonight, and if they find you, you will not help anyone.

ch3_beata.speaker: beata
ch3_beata.text: I know people who are hiding others. I will ask them to look for him. Go home, Emmanuel. Tell Aline her brother was alive an hour ago.

choices.text: "How will I know if you find him?"

ch3_beata.speaker: beata
ch3_beata.text: You will know. A shopkeeper hears everything, remember?

ch3_end.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_end.text: Not yet. But Mama Beata saw him an hour ago. He was alive, Aline. He ran into the banana groves. She has people looking for him.

ch3_end.speaker: aline
ch3_end.text: Alive. An hour ago, he was alive.

ch3_end.speaker: emmanuel
ch3_end.text: I found this at the football field.

ch3_end.speaker: narrator
ch3_end.text: Aline takes the small mended sandal and holds it against her chest.

ch3_end.speaker: joseph
ch3_end.text: Claudine. Eric. Come in, come in. You are safe here, as safe as anyone is tonight.

ch3_end.speaker: joseph
ch3_end.text: Gasana, old friend. Sit. Rest your legs.

ch3_end.speaker: joseph
ch3_end.text: I will go for Gasana myself before dawn. He should not be alone.

ch3_end.speaker: joseph
ch3_end.text: We will make room in the storage room. For everyone who comes to this door.

ch3_end.speaker: aline
ch3_end.text: Joseph, if they find us here, they will—

ch3_end.speaker: joseph
ch3_end.text: Then they must not find you. Quietly, and together. That is how we will do this.
